title: Retain the diagnostic cause when a committed federation append cannot settle locally
outcome: After a canonical federation append commits but sender-local outcome retention fails, the operator can identify the local retention cause without losing the truthful committed outcome and exact-retry guidance.
acceptance: Preserve the underlying local settlement error through an appropriate diagnostic path without exposing delivery payloads or credential material.
Keep the API's truthful central-append-committed wording, original status/kind and exact retry behavior; cover representative storage and conflict causes.
